title: VENSUKO Launcher 0.14.2 - Keychain & Sign-out Hotfix
notes:
VENSUKO Launcher 0.14.2 - Keychain & Sign-out Hotfix

- Fixed account sign-out failing with Unsupported secure-session key by accepting the restricted Supabase session, user and PKCE keys.
- macOS now uses a single isolated Keychain credential instead of dozens of session shards, avoiding repeated credential prompts on startup.
- In-memory session caching prevents repeated Keychain reads while VENSUKO is running. Tokens remain in the operating system's protected credential store.
- Mac users need to sign in once again after updating; old Lumorix/VENSUKO Keychain items are retained and not read, migrated or deleted automatically.
- Windows and macOS receive the same launcher version. Full Apple Developer ID signing is still required to avoid every possible permission prompt across future Mac updates.
